title: No Missed Calls: What That’s Worth to Brothers Plumbing
summary: For decades, Brothers Plumbing called every customer back. Less than 3% of after-hours calls ever became jobs. It wasn't for lack of trying but because customers simply don't wait. Here's what changed when the phone started answering itself.
